svg.title: Figure 5. Considère construction for the onset of necking
svg.desc: Two stacked plots sharing a true-strain axis from 0 to 0.45, for an illustrative power-law material with n = 0.22. Top: load per original area rises, peaks at true strain 0.22, then falls. Bottom: the true-stress curve rises with decreasing slope while the dotted hardening-rate curve falls steeply from high values; they cross at true strain 0.22, marked with a circle and labeled Considère: d sigma t over d epsilon t equals sigma t, so the necking strain equals n. A dashed vertical line links the crossing to the load maximum. To the left the region is labeled stable uniform stretching; to the right a shaded region is labeled unstable, neck grows.
